# Shun — teaching others does not settle how a student may receive care
## 1. Core thesis: care is a chosen practice, a wanted relation and a contested use of authority

Shun's strongest continuous question is how an instructor can remain a student with tastes, doubts, fatigue and a wish to be cared for. Her teaching is substantial: fruit preparation, puppet lessons, play, supervision, protective intervention and a chosen return to duty are represented actions. So are her own tea, sweets, clothes, skincare, bodily ease, wanted company and requests to be indulged. Those ends deserve attention before any institutional benefit. The adult form's continued request after returning in EVENT805 is especially decisive: receiving care cannot be allocated exclusively to the small body and then declared outgrown. [BA:bond:10011:002/003/008/009; BA:event:805:008–009; BA:group:2602; BA:event:859:009.]

Her authority creates contrary evidence that the generous reading must carry. The puppet lesson includes children's fear and delight, while a subsequent adult inspection continues despite a distance request. A hug can be wanted yet introduced by a threat. She supports Kokona's refusal of dangerous infiltration, yet later joins a misleading cover story; she also physically punishes the three gang children, whose pain, subsequent escape and retaliation defeat a completed-reform conclusion. Competence, affection and harm are therefore differentiated acts, not a person-wide verdict in either direction. [BA:bond:10011:003/009; BA:event:859:006–007/012–014.]

The form comparisons make this question sharper without resolving it into a biological theory. The small body's failed dessert expectation, restricted reach and welcomed play contrast with retained professional knowledge, privacy and refusal; the swim repertoire includes both actual pleasure and wanted recognition as an adult partner. Profile statements, textual transformations and adopted aliases have different force. They support bounded literary comparison, not a universal unchanged-mind axiom, a pharmacological account, or a total calendar connecting all variants. The separately allocated10144 written object receives substantial treatment in §9.2; it is not silently absorbed as another witnessed episode. [BA:bond:10025:002/003/006/020; BA:bond:10143:003/005; BA:character_data:10025:profile_and_dialog; BA:character_data:10144:profile_and_dialog.]

The resulting thesis is conditional: Shun's teaching can be chosen and worthwhile while her role fails to accommodate her own needs or her recipients' boundaries. Listening, shared play and particular successful ends show alternatives to unlimited sacrifice and compelled care. Neither eventual pleasure nor a return to work grants retrospective permission for every method. This monograph completes an evidence-bounded character argument under the existing home; separate Meihua institution, Shun–Kokona, Saya-recipient, Sensei, ensemble and register duties remain required work.
